verdict.rationale: Paddle documents sales-assisted invoices: teams can draft and send invoices for subscriptions and collect payment manually rather than charging a card on file, and issuing an invoice auto-creates a subscription. The evidence does not show a hosted invoice page with online payment. Dunning and Retain notifications are documented only for failed payments on automatically-collected subscriptions, not as reminders for unpaid invoices. Missing for 10: a hosted invoice payment page or link, automatic reminders for outstanding invoices, independent corroboration.
